qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Operates Vodafone Spain (acquired May 2024 via €5B debt-heavy buyout). Faces intense price deflation and churn in the Spanish telecom market from aggressive low-cost competitors (Digi Spain) and scale incumbents (Telefónica, MasOrange). Lacks pricing power >= inflation, with historical ROIC well below the 12% threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing Power). Highly leveraged buyout vehicle operating Vodafone Spain. Spain is one of Europe's most commoditized, price-deflationary telecom markets where ultra-low-cost disruptors (Digi) preclude pricing power >= inflation, resulting in sub-hurdle historical ROIC (<12%).
qualitative.evidence: Zegona acquired Vodafone Spain in 2024 for €5B financed with heavy debt (€3.2B+ net debt, ~2.3-3.1x EBITDAaL). Historical ROIC under Vodafone and post-acquisition is negative to low single-digit, failing the 12% hurdle. The Spanish market suffers from relentless promotional discounting and lack of pricing power.
